title: Fee-Schedule Amounts per Unit, PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
Each PAP supply item billed to coverage under the PAP Supply Replenishment Program has one fee-schedule amount per unit. The amount is the figure before the coverage class's allowed percentage is applied, and the same amounts stand on all six resupply schedules.

| HCPCS | Item | Fee-schedule amount per unit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| A7030 | Full face mask | 158.45 |
| A7031 | Full face mask cushion | 58.19 |
| A7034 | Nasal mask or pillows interface | 98.07 |
| A7032 | Nasal mask cushion | 33.79 |
| A7033 | Nasal pillows pair | 21.69 |
| A7035 | Headgear | 41.47 |
| A7036 | Chinstrap | 18.98 |
| A7037 | Standard tubing | 26.52 |
| A4604 | Heated tubing | 45.93 |
| A7038 | Disposable filter | 3.73 |
| A7039 | Non-disposable filter | 11.92 |
| A7046 | Humidifier water chamber | 26.19 |

## Applicability by schedule

The table applies unchanged to the Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial HMO and Commercial PPO Resupply Schedules, and is also recorded on the Self-Pay Supply Subscription with the same figures.

## Notes

- A figure in this table is a per-unit amount; it is not the amount a payer pays, because the coverage class's allowed percentage still applies to it.
- These amounts are distinct from the cash prices charged on self-pay lines, which are a separate price list.
